LESSON: SWIMMING (OPTIONAL)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.1: Swimming (Optional)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Swimming (Optional). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Swimming (Optional)
2. Practise Swimming (Optional) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Swimming (Optional)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Swimming (Optional)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Swimming (Optional). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Swimming (Optional) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Swimming (Optional) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Swimming (Optional)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Swimming (Optional). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Swimming (Optional) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Swimming (Optional) in the examples.
2. Explain Swimming (Optional) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Swimming (Optional).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Swimming (Optional) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Swimming (Optional) important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Swimming (Optional)
2. Practise Swimming (Optional) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Swimming (Optional)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
